propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns [] for both git failure and successful-but-empty blame, making them indistinguishable and preventing proper error detection

derive_caused_by tallies blame results across multiple paths; if blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, the strict-majority test runs over a subset and can produce incorrect caused_by links
git blame on historical trees runs on every bug close without explicit --caused-by; under blobless promisor this faults blobs one at a time, risking partial failures
clone guidance must document the accepted degradation: blobless clone (--filter=blob:none) is 15x faster and 68.7 MiB vs full 1.04 GiB, and --filter=tree:0 must not be used (3.57 GiB, 3.4x larger)
derive_caused_by must abort and return None when any per-path blame fails after _blame_file_commits is fixed to distinguish failure from empty result
